name: ohun
description: Ohun V2 — accessible, secure, private real-time messaging

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ohun/design-tokens && npm run build -w @ohun/contracts && npm run build -w @ohun/api-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ohun/web && npm run build -w @ohun/api && npm run build -w @ohun/mobile
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ohun/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ohun/api
